$comment: Credential policy is a Ministry decision (SSO, verification, complexity). These are the review build's placeholders, configurable as data so the decision changes no code.

reset.$commentActivation: An activation link is the same mechanism with a different window. A reset answers a person who is at their keyboard now; an activation reaches somebody who has just been told an account exists for them and may not read their mail today. One hour would expire before it arrived.
